source_text: The Ashley Montagu Resolution, adopted in 1996, explicitly grouped non-therapeutic male circumcision and female genital mutilation (FGM) under the umbrella of "genital mutilation of children," advocating their equal prohibition as violations of children's rights to bodily integrity. [1]
